## College admissions and blood glucose (100% of the HW6 grade)

Complete the HW6 coding problems:
[DataHub](https://r.datahub.berkeley.edu/hub/user-redirect/git-pull?repo=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fberkeley-stat131a%2F131a-code-fall-2026&urlpath=rstudio%2F)

- The HW6 coding problems are located in `131a-code-fall-2026/hw/hw6` on DataHub.

- You are free to download the HW6 repository and work locally in RStudio or Positron, if you wish.

- **You should not need to use an LLM to complete any of the code in this HW.** Everything you're asked to do on this HW is fair game for an exam setting.

**Submit a PDF containing the code and output.** Render your PDF with RStudio or Positron.
